title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in this app and set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view.
